title: Wind Chimes in the Rain
description: A surreal dreamlike scene shows multiple hanging wind chimes with transparent tubes and bells suspended over swirling ethereal water. In the foreground a white sheep looks upward while a pale yellow cow stands in the midground, both surrounded by glowing light, falling rain, and swirling pastel energy under a luminous cloudy sky.
